timeline_events.title: Kensho Arashi's Betrayal
timeline_events.description: Kensho Arashi, at age 23, lost his sight during a betrayal within his secret dojo, leading him to spend the next 23 years perfecting hyper-perception.
timeline_events.quote: Lost his sight at age 23 in a betrayal within the dojo. Spent 23 years blind, perfecting hyper-perception.
